back: A decline in the quality and productivity of land.
The removal of topsoil by water or wind faster than new soil forms.
The filling of rivers and dams with soil washed from the land.
The process by which land in dry areas becomes more like a desert, mainly through human activity and drought.
Keeping more livestock on land than its grass can support.

front: How do contour ridges reduce erosion?
back: They run across the slope and slow run-off, so water soaks in instead of carrying soil away.

front: Name four causes of land degradation.
back: Deforestation, overgrazing, veld fires, illegal gold panning (also poor farming, sand extraction, urban expansion).

front: Name four measures against land degradation.
back: Afforestation, contour ridges, rotational grazing, conservation farming (also gully repair, fire guards, laws).

front: Why is soil erosion called an effect, not a cause?
back: It results from activities such as overgrazing and deforestation that leave soil bare.
